race.comment: Tough race. NAVY HEART (9) was much better getting to 2000m third up when beaten under two lengths in a similar grade of race. Now to 2200m fourth up, she should be set to peak and the Maher yard are just unbeatable over a staying trip lately. CABLE DANCER (1) comes through the same race at Seymour and was only second up there as a $7 chance. The fresh run was good and up in trip suits much better. JEAN GEORGES (14) was just fair on soft going at Seymour last time but had looked good winning his maiden prior and can improve. TISHMAN (4) resumes having won fresh last time in, watch the betting. SHE'S A CON (12) next best.
